entities.summary: Matthew Nagy is an American professional football coach and former quarterback who is currently the offensive coordinator of the New York Giants of the National Football League (NFL). He was the head coach of the Chicago Bears from 2018 to 2021. Nagy served as the offensive coordinator of the Kansas City Chiefs in two separate stints, from 2016 to 2017 and from 2023 to 2025.
